arguments.analyst: Observed data: conservative single/paired edits score high (O1 3.90, O2 3.88, O7 3.75, O6 3.67), while disruptive edits crater (O4, O5, O8 ~1.3). S202G and I136T appear in high-menu entries; T62A was observed at 3.20 in a triple with K85R (also in low O5), so favor conservative polarity-neutral substitutions and avoid proline/charged-nonsense changes.
arguments.hypothesis: Conservative, near-isosteric substitutions (e.g., S202G, I136T, Y151H-type polar swaps) retain brightness, while proline insertion and nonconservative basic/charged swaps (L195P, F114S, E213K) abolish fluorescence; hence top candidates should cluster near ~3.5 with no disruptive edits.
